sources.excerpt: 92 POINTS 17 /20 Maria Rigol Ordi Brut Nature Reserva NV Sant Sadurní d'Anoia, Penedès, Catalunya (Catalonia Cataluña), Spain Maria Rigol Ordi is a 5th generation family of Cava makers since 1897, based in Sant Sadurní d’Anoia. This organic cava blends Xarel.lo, Macabeu, and Parellada, from 280-450m and the 2019 vintage. It spent at least 36 months on lees prior to a zero disgorge in March 2024. Almond blossom, green apple, toasted biscuit is kissed with anise, and lifted with a shining lemony acidity that hums on the saline finish. Lovely depth and complexity here.
